config_metadata.module: Module 5: Trust, Safety and Assurance Engine
config_metadata.author: Student 2 (Trust & Assurance Lead)
config_metadata.description: Baseline operational and algorithmic parameters for Digital Mohalla's assurance pipeline. Every threshold and weight represents an initial experimental hypothesis to be evaluated via time-ordered holdout testing (Overview §5, NFR-D-01, FR-B-09).
changelog: 1.2.0-iteration1-draft (2026-10-13, Student 2): similarity weighting defined (team decision D17): value band 0.4, category 0.4, duration 0.2; band closeness 1.0 same, 0.5 adjacent, 0.0 two apart; duration closeness shorter / longer; the 0.5 floor applies to each outcome's weight. No other value changed.

1.1.0-iteration1-draft (2026-10-11, integration): s4_review_similarity active in iteration 1 (ADR-0007); rule R6_SPARSE uses rho_sup (ADR-0008); locality_a11 parameters added so one versioned file holds every parameter (NFR-D-01). No numeric value changed.

1.3.0-iteration1-draft (2026-10-13, Student 2, decisions D18 and D19): S1 measures mutual reviews among the subject's rating partners (s1_min_out_degree replaced by s1_min_partners, same value 3); S4 uses character 3-gram TF-IDF over the subject's received reviews (s4_char_ngram, s4_min_reviews); retaliation check: a review counts as negative when its lowest rating is at most retaliation_negative_rating_max. No other value changed.

1.3.1-iteration2-draft (2026-11-14, Student 2, build A1, ADR-0010 proposed, review DM09): rule_order checks R4 before R3, so a HIGH-value request from a borrower with no history and rho below rho_sup is held for a moderator (high_value_low_confidence) as FR-B-07 says, instead of reaching the lender as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. The engine now follows rule_order from this file. No other value changed; config 1.4.0 (DA-15) adds the remaining iteration 2 parameters when their features are built.

1.3.2-iteration2-draft (2026-11-15, Student 1, build F4 groundwork): scheduler_b13 timers copied unchanged from design config 1.4.0 (ADR-0012), because M2 (party response deadline), F4 and F5 read them. Timers only; no trust, detection or policy value changed, so every assessment is the same as under 1.3.1.

1.3.3-iteration2-draft (2026-11-15, Student 2, Slice 2: A3, A4, A9): copied unchanged from design config 1.4.0 (DA-15, DA-22): trust_estimation_alg1.pair_repeat_discount; manipulation_detection_alg3 with S2, S3 and S5 active (iteration_2_active), new_account_recent_window_days and s5_linkage (invitation tree only); ranking_alg5 for search retrieval and ranking. New section reviews_d1 with the review window (14 days) and edit window (24 hours) of FR/NFR v1.4 and the rating dimensions of the synthetic data. roles_and_metrics and population_baseline wait for A5 (Slice 3).

prior.rationale: Uniform prior representing complete absence of evidence without bias.

recency_decay.rationale: Balances recent performance with seasonal borrowing behavior.

credible_interval.rationale: Quantifies uncertainty to distinguish sparse from rich evidence.

similarity_weighting.formula: sigma_raw = 0.4 * band_closeness + 0.4 * (same category) + 0.2 * (shorter / longer duration); outcome weight uses max(similarity_floor, sigma_raw); request_similarity (rule R4) is the recency-weighted mean of sigma_raw
similarity_weighting.rationale: Weights past evidence by category, value band, and duration relevance.

pair_repeat_discount.formula: w_i := w_i * factor^m_i, where m_i = earlier VALID outcomes of the same subject with the same observer in the window before outcome i
pair_repeat_discount.source: Overview §5.13 threat 'trivial exchanges used to manufacture reputation'; DA-15
pair_repeat_discount.rationale: Many short loans between the same two accounts add little independent evidence. Halving each repeat inside 30 days bounds a pair's contribution to under two outcomes without discarding honest repeat loans.

graph_traversal.rationale: Limits search horizon to prevent computational explosion and noise propagation.

attenuation_decay.rationale: Progressively discounts trust confidence as path length increases.

aggregation.rationale: Strictly caps indirect evidence below direct evidence to prevent false trust.

baseline.rationale: Fallback prior mean when target user has zero verified direct events.

signal_weights.source: Overview §5.6, §5.13; ADR-0007; DA-15 (all five signals active in iteration 2)

corroboration_guard.rationale: Prevents single-signal false alarms (e.g. friend groups) from reaching Level 4.

retaliation_check.source: Algorithm doc §5 (Suspected Retaliation Check), FR-T-09, decision D19
retaliation_check.rationale: A review whose lowest rating is at most this value, posted within retaliation_window_days after the subject's complaint against the reviewer, about a loan whose return was confirmed, is set aside as suspected retaliation pending moderator review.

s5_linkage.definition: m = other accounts invited by the same inviter as the subject within window_days, plus accounts the subject invited, that also rated the subject; device and IP are not collected (FR-A-03 is iteration 3)
s5_linkage.source: Algorithm doc §5 S5 'linkage where legitimately available'; A11 invitation table; DA-15

thresholds.source: Overview §5.8, §5.11; rho_sup used by R3 and R6_SPARSE (ADR-0008)

scheduler_b13.source: FR-B-10, B-12, B-14, B-16, B-17, B-18; Test Plan gap UI-5; State_Machine_Design_v3.md §4
scheduler_b13.rationale: Starting values for a neighbourhood loan of a few days; they are timers, not trust parameters, but live in the same versioned file so every value is traceable (NFR-D-01).

ranking_alg5.owner: Student 2 (Module 4 meaning-based search and ranking); keyword retrieval Student 1

retrieval.embedding_model: to be chosen in ADR-0016 after the memory test; 384 dimensions provisional

weights.source: Overview §4 Tier 1 formula (0.40 similarity, 0.30 trust, 0.15 availability, 0.10 distance, 0.05 recency); distance replaced by same community because no coordinates are stored (NFR-PR-01)

lender_evidence.value: posterior mean when n_eff >= n_min, otherwise the population baseline (never a penalty for new lenders)
lender_evidence.shown_to_users: as factors with confidence, never as this number (FR-S-04, NFR-U-01)

ranking_alg5.rationale: A transparent hand-weighted formula with no training data (Overview §4 Tier 1); learning-to-rank needs pilot click logs and stays in FYP-2.

reviews_d1.source: FR/NFR v1.4 timer table (review window 14 d, edit window 24 h; FR-T-09); dimensions as in data/generators/world.py
reviews_d1.rationale: The review window matches retaliation_window_days, so a review that could retaliate is still inside the check; a short edit window lets a party fix a typo without rewriting history.
